evidence: 0x402070 decodes configuration via 0x401980: Base64 -> add 0x7a modulo 256 -> XOR 0x59 -> RC4(Getong538).
0x401d80 reads a staged DLL, calls 0x401d10 to transform it with RC4(Kother599 plus terminating NUL), and passes the same buffer to the manual image mapper at 0x401000.

The mapper validates MZ/PE, allocates image memory, copies sections, applies relocations/imports/protections, and calls the native entry point. Export lookup at 0x401470 supplies the separately called module export.
0x401c20 chooses C: through F: Program Files/AppPatch staging; 0x401a40 fetches with WinInet and writes the response. The load/download loop retries after Sleep.
Position-independent pushad/call/pop prologue and one-shot flag; reverse cyclic-key XOR loop at 0x2601.
Module-path sibling suffix replacement, CreateFile/WriteFile/CreateProcess dispatch, then restoration of host registers and computed host continuation at 0x2709.
The appended bytes are outside declared sections and SizeOfImage. Presence is proven; execution of this appended stub by the outer PE is not claimed.
Payload starts at 0x2973, length 85713. The cyclic key is the reverse of bytes 1..19 of the stored 20-byte key.
Exact hash documented in the local SIGNATURE_BASE_MAL_Ramnit_May19_1 rule metadata; scan also matches the Ramnit import-hash signature.
UPX host has an appended parasite. A separate copy truncated to 0x14800 and with the third section raw size restored to 0x7200 can be unpacked by UPX.

Recovered wrapper uses junk API calls and a LastError/invalid-CreateFile opaque predicate. CPU emulation with inert API hooks recovers a flattened stage using PEB traversal and ROL7/XOR export hashing (final XOR 0x4b50fa82).

The decoded stage resolves NtQuerySystemInformation, NtProtectVirtualMemory, NtAllocateVirtualMemory and NtFreeVirtualMemory, then reconstructs another packed PE. Synthetic API outcomes are used only for extraction, not as evidence of real Windows execution.
Recovered packed PE has a renamed .rmnet UPX0 section. Repairing the label in a copy allows UPX unpacking (53248 bytes).
Main at 0x402c5b resolves the browser executable from registry/environment fallback, installs a ZwWriteVirtualMemory hook through 0x402b1e, launches a process, and removes the hook via 0x402b62.
The hook invokes a remote manual mapper at 0x402002: VirtualAllocEx, payload WriteProcessMemory, and remote helper installation.

The inner image carries the same parasitic sibling stub, compiled autorun drive-spread templates, and an embedded VBScript HTML infection drop-and-run template. Existing rules plus the new parasite rules emit four hostile findings.
No evidence substantiates the collector-provided WannaCry label.

Recognize contiguous XOR/sibling write/process-launch code with nearby host-register restoration as a hostile parasite; separately identify the paired Ramnit PIC fingerprint.
Add suspicious native DLL HTTP URL references with suffix/query boundaries; raise the existing filtered binary external-IPv4 URL reference to suspicious.
